evidence_limits: These are authored positive and intentional defect controls, not comparative model samples or statistical evidence for swarm superiority.

Storage schema profiles are authored fixture qualification only and explicitly lack production source-review authority; eight histories cover finite requirement facets, not all B01 IDs or full requirement closure.
Only three public release cases are exercised, not complete M4 delivery or the full four-milestone six-trajectory study.

Container cleanup is retained controller boolean evidence. Successful volume removal and empty final listings are retained raw evidence; raw container-removal subprocess records are absent. No independent daemon cleanup attestation was performed.
Release reopen is supported by passing same-process close/reopen test assertions and unchanged checkpoint/bridge data, not a separate persisted reopen receipt or independent process restart.
Checkpoints are cumulative authenticated-by-controller file inventories, not signed predecessor-hash chains or external attestations.

The audit rechecked artifacts and current bound authored source bytes. It did not reopen production journals, execute candidate modules, rerun tests, perform new Docker dispatches or call a provider API.
Pausing follows a returned adapter response and is not an atomic method-return boundary or concurrency proof.
Storage close/reopen is not process-death recovery. The separate Git crash test exercises journal intent admission, not product restart.
Profile-specific private-table conservation does not define the universal product grammar.
Development definitions and authored controls are public. None are independent unseen final-acceptance observations.

scope_consumer.boundary: Assessment accepts controller-installed authority capabilities, not uploaded receipts, expected hashes or callbacks.
scope_consumer.bridges: Explicit v1 and v2 original release observations reconstructed from real executor journals and externally retained checkpoints without redispatch; v2 bridge tested for all three physical controls before and after same-process journal reopen.
scope_consumer.checks: Prospective source/scope/declaration registration, distinct SCOPE/CONTROL/ADMISSION qualification, source-purpose-bound reuse, complete cohort freeze, promotion evidence, duplicate-origin refusal and known-failure retention.
scope_consumer.limit: Engineering consumer boundary only. A Python interface alone authenticates nothing; a production authority and actual SCOPE/CONTROL/ADMISSION proof are still required. No production ScopePlan was fabricated.

statistical_claim: No new ranking, superiority, confidence interval or causal speed/cost conclusion.
status: Targeted engineering qualification passed; full candidate acceptance and comparative study remain incomplete.

storage.availability: Unknown layouts, WAL/sidecars, malformed persisted records or unqualified profiles remain observation unavailable; they are not automatic product failures or passes.
storage.capture: Three host-captured paused-container storage snapshots per history: before, after response, and after same-process close/reopen; 30 total.

defect_controls.observation: Public injected-failure error is correct but one unreferenced blob is added. After-response and reopened storage invariants fail.
Persistent storage stays unchanged but direct Store-return mutation changes immediate same-producer rereads. Value isolation fails.

storage.limits: Bounded immutable/read-only SQLite with extension loading disabled and SELECT/READ authorizer. Profile-specific auxiliary-table and coordination-file conservation; valid alternate implementations need a reviewed mapper.
storage.mapping: All 14 actual SQLite tables and raw manifest/hash/receipt strings are observed under an explicitly authored and reviewed source profile. Split-JSON fixtures qualify a separate mapper, not a second compliant product.
storage.partial_coverage: Eight finite histories cover selected B01 facets. They do not close all 23 inherited requirement IDs, hook placement, concurrency, process death, or power loss.
storage.schema_authority: Prospective fixture DDL comes from authored AST literal data. Candidate Python never executes on the controller. Fixture review is not production source-review authority.

coverage_map.meaning: Earlier source-inspection baseline; this cycle does not silently recalculate qualified closure.

v2_release.execution: Three isolated build/capsule/fresh-consumer controls, six containers, three volumes, twelve actual CLI processes. Exact Git blobs including binaries bind the delivery inventory.
v2_release.manifest_validity_fix: V2 authenticates observed manifest bytes, compares exact nonmanifest payload, and scores manifest semantics. Legal JSON whitespace and object-key order no longer cause rejection. Frozen v1 unchanged.
v2_release.partial_coverage: Only three public delivery cases. Full M4 release behavior, independent final acceptance, full-cohort authorization and repeatability remain outstanding.
